Title: ETABS source import and audit
When: Before any OpenSees analysis and after any source EDB modification
Why: Preserve geometric and load identity; prevent silent conversion loss
How: Launch 01 workflow; extract read-only source geometry/connectivity/loads; verify section assignment and source EDB SHA
Which_Inputs: Verified EDB, source export JSON/CSV, section and load audit
Who_Accountable_Roles: ETABS model owner supplies source; structural engineer checks mapping; software maintainer checks extraction
Acceptance_Gate: SOURCE_CHECKED only after independent source comparison; export complete is not gravity equivalent

Title: Project identity and nonlinear readiness
When: Before model configuration, changed source models and production run selection
Why: Do not accept a research card or checkbox as material validation
How: Select project, bind exact nonlinear builder and SHA; inspect preflight, material/FSAM mappings and signed evidence
Which_Inputs: Project source, Model_Config_V118, nonlinear material definition, readiness draft
Who_Accountable_Roles: Researcher selects model; licensed/qualified reviewer verifies physical evidence; code author maintains checks
Acceptance_Gate: MODEL_BOUND_SIGNOFF is a claim, not physical verification

Title: Material/section calibration
When: Before nonlinear frame or wall response and before sensitivity runs
Why: Avoid unsupported transfer of nominal/specimen parameters
How: Link paper specimen, material command, units, reinforcement and reproduction curves; retain differences and uncertainty
Which_Inputs: Concrete01/02/CM, Steel02/MPF; M30 Fe500 and PEER references
Who_Accountable_Roles: Researcher records assumptions; structural reviewer validates actual reinforcement; testing expert reviews benchmark fit
Acceptance_Gate: REFERENCE_ONLY until independent specimen and project section evidence pass

Title: RC core wall and opening verification
Why: Unresolved first-step X wall failure may contaminate global seismic response
How: Verify four-node orientation, FSAM regions, openings, constraints, force/stress finiteness; run ZERO then X/Y/XY
Which_Inputs: ETABS wall mesh, mapping, actual wall reinforcement, element 110280 traces
Who_Accountable_Roles: Earthquake/structural engineer resolves physical cause; numerical engineer reviews solver logs
Acceptance_Gate: First-step X failure remains BLOCKED until verified native evidence

Title: Gravity load paths and reactions
When: Immediately after assembly and before modal/dynamic analysis
Why: Equilibrium alone cannot establish ETABS agreement or correct slab/beam/wall load transfer
How: Verify no double self-weight, section volumes and 32 common support reactions plus source scenarios
Which_Inputs: Gravity profiles, ETABS load audit, source supports, reactions
Who_Accountable_Roles: Structural engineer compares ETABS; model developer corrects conversion without modifying EDB

Title: Modal, mass and stiffness
When: After verified gravity and before all seismic methods
Why: Period, Tn90, modal mass and stiffness determine integration/spectrum evidence
How: Use exact ULS/SLS state; record modes T1-X/Y and cumulative participation and modal residual
Which_Inputs: Source mass, eigen solver, model supports, modal output
Who_Accountable_Roles: Earthquake engineer reviews modes and mass; software engineer profiles solver
Acceptance_Gate: 20 extracted modes are not automatically Tn90 nor section design acceptance

Title: NBC equivalent static method
When: After validated source Aw/T1 workbook and model identity
How: Read authoritative source Aw and adopted periods directly from original project workbook; trace Excel cell and SHA
Which_Inputs: NBC105_RS_Scaling.xlsx source, adopted Aw-X/Y T1-X/Y, EDB identity
Who_Accountable_Roles: Researcher validates workbook assumptions; qualified engineer reviews governing NBC clauses
Acceptance_Gate: Formula reproduction is not unquestioned code acceptance

Title: Modal response-spectrum method
When: After mass/mode and NBC spectrum checks
Why: Cross-check elastic demand relative to ETABS and TH
How: Run ULS/SLS CQC, X/Y scaling and signed eccentricity evidence with source-consistent stiffness
Which_Inputs: Modes, spectra, mass, story force/drift and base reactions
Who_Accountable_Roles: Seismic engineer reviews method and ETABS comparison; maintainer checks extracted outputs
Acceptance_Gate: Independent RSA comparison needed; summed floor forces not automatically section-cut story shear

Title: Linear time-history XY/YX
When: After modal/mass checks and before nonlinear performance benchmarking
Why: Elastic response baseline and performance profiling for complete paired records
How: Run both orientations full duration; preserve response histories; test factorOnce/vector reactions only under valid assumptions
Which_Inputs: Verified paired Acc(g), configured dt, Rayleigh damping and recorder bundle
Who_Accountable_Roles: Researcher runs; engineer reviews all-story response; software maintainer benchmarks native solver and recorder
Acceptance_Gate: One complete XY orientation does not mean the paired case is complete

Title: FVD/BRB device evidence
When: Before enabling damped and BRB outrigger variants
Why: Device forces, energy, axial orientation and connection stiffness dominate interpretation
How: Map exact device tags; benchmark native force/velocity/energy, dimensional Cd alpha and stroke; compare reference tests
Which_Inputs: FVD Maxwell/exponential links, BRB hysteretic/strain parameters
Who_Accountable_Roles: Researcher sources devices; specialist checks manufacturer/experimental data and admissible extrapolation
Acceptance_Gate: Native recorder smoke test alone is not component validation

Title: Soil C matched earthquake records
Why: Avoid double scaling, waveform mismatch and unacceptable record provenance
How: Verify 16 component SHA, dt/duration and signs; document SeismoMatch originals and NBC pair scaling
Which_Inputs: Eight actual Soil C pairs, Gorkha duration and Loma Prieta mismatch review
Who_Accountable_Roles: Researcher obtains session logs; seismologist/earthquake reviewer confirms source categorization and site class
Acceptance_Gate: Source waveform presence does not validate spectral matching or site Vs30

Title: Full nonlinear XY/YX history
When: Only after geometry, walls, materials, gravity and motion prerequisites pass
Why: Primary thesis demand and hysteretic assessment
How: Fresh domain for ZERO/X/Y/XY and each record; collect accepted steps, response forces, energy and completion gate
Which_Inputs: M0–M6 geometry and devices, ULS/SLS, validated record pairs
Who_Accountable_Roles: Researcher executes; numerical specialist diagnoses failures; structural advisor reviews acceptance
Acceptance_Gate: Current first-step X wall failure is unresolved; full validated suite not complete

Title: M0–M6 comparative and sensitivity study
When: After full cases complete with matching model and input identity
Why: Test effectiveness of damped/conventional outriggers, belt and cap alternatives
How: Match accepted runs by source SHA, intensity, orientation and duration; compute demand and uncertainty
Which_Inputs: 7 variants × ULS/SLS × 8 pairs × XY/YX = planned 224 histories
Who_Accountable_Roles: Researcher prepares study; advisor reviews uncertainty, limitations and comparison
Acceptance_Gate: No certified optimum from missing/failed/truncated runs

Title: Literature and scientific provenance
When: Whenever a code parameter, numerical method or design assumption changes
Why: Make every claim traceable to the actual cited paper, version and license
How: Record DOI, authors, publication, citations source/date, paragraph/section, PDF license; audit code citations
Which_Inputs: Public bibliography and private research PDFs; code citation occurrence register
Who_Accountable_Roles: Researcher curates references; source verifier checks metadata; rights owner controls redistribution
Acceptance_Gate: Paper availability is not experimental project calibration or redistribution permission

Title: Output review and decision gates
When: After each solver stage, failure or proposed code acceptance
Why: Separate source discovery, numeric convergence, ETABS equivalence, component calibration and code compliance
How: Save original logs/hashes, JSON, plots, independent comparisons and identified missing evidence; record human review
Which_Inputs: Model-bound run metadata, accepted histories and independent review evidence
Who_Accountable_Roles: Researcher submits evidence; reviewer decides engineering acceptance; maintainer maintains record formats
Acceptance_Gate: No implicit approval for missing evidence or a partial run
